baseline.description: Existing reported-termination server policy and compatibility controls.

scope: Actual Express-registered accept handler through loopback HTTP with synthetic authenticated authority and requestDb sentinel; baseline/final positive policy controls. Source review of the final UI/shared/re-export diff. No production or Git changes.
limits: Allowed cases stop with HTTP 418 accepted:false at requestDb, before DB objects/queries/writes; this is not successful acceptance.
Separate actual React suite replaces fetch responses; its 12 behavioral baseline failures plus four controls and 16 final passes belong to its owner.
PGlite acceptance write fixtures, integrated cohort, whole-tree TypeScript, browser qualification, hooks and publication belong to root; test counts overlap.
Client-reported finish metadata is not trusted attestation; omission/forgery and unsupported camelCase request aliases remain outside the correction.
Unknown/absent status is permitted, unconfirmed, and does not certify completeness, scientific correctness or filing readiness.
